solution.p: 4zV\gt31 is not linear because it multiplies two variables together.
x^{2}+z^{2}=-48 and \pi r^{2}\neq50\pi are not linear because variables are raised to the second power.
\left|-1.9x-6\right|=33 is not linear because a variable is within absolute value bars.
That leaves 16p-1\lt14 and r\sqrt{20}=-67\text{,} which are both linear.
